name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Exploration Lab
summary:
Step into the introductory experience of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where systems of the human body come to life in stunning 3D. Designed for elementary, middle, and high school learners, this hands-on experience provides a broad introduction to human anatomy through interactive exploration and discovery.
